name: Rivertown Music + Arts Camp
description_short: Music and arts day camp run by Rivertown Music on the CSI grounds at 300 North Broadway, for ages 5 to 12, Monday to Thursday 10 to 3. Campers rotate through small group music lessons, theatre games, improv, singing and crafts, and each week has its own focus, so they can join for one week or all four.
notes: 2026 season July 6 to 30, Mondays to Thursdays 10 am to 3 pm, $425 a week, materials included. Campers bring their own lunch and snack. Weekly dates are the Monday to Thursday weeks inside July 6 to 30. $25 off for current Rivertown students who sign up with a friend new to the studio (through March 31). The studio's own address is 20 Bridge St, Nyack.
